description: Ready-to-paste client config for one MCP server. Check installKnown first: when it is false there is no `config` in the reply, because Stork holds no verified install method, and `instructions` links the publisher's own setup guide. Do not invent a command in that case. installMethod is 'remote' (connect by URL) or 'npm' (local stdio). authSummary says when the user must sign in.

client.description: The user's MCP client: cursor, claude-desktop, claude-code, vscode, zed. Any other name gets the common mcpServers JSON.

name: stork_get_install_config
